Stock-based consideration: SPAC common shares issued under the Exchange Ratio, based on a $600,000,000 Transaction Value, with accompanying SPAC warrants and SPAC options; no cash consideration is described.
SPAC Exchange Warrants; SPAC Exchange Options; Exchange Ratio for SPAC Common Shares.
The SPAC Common Shares exchange ratio is the quotient of (Transaction Value divided by 10) over Company Outstanding Shares, rounded to four decimal places; the SPAC Earnout Shares exchange ratio is one-third of 12,500,000 divided by the aggregate number of Company Outstanding Shares, with separate calculations for SPAC Class A, SPAC Class B, and SPAC Class C Earnout Shares.
